args.title: Brannock Legal – 2026 renewal (features first, pricing stated)
args.body:
Subject: Your Halcyon Software subscription renews on 15 November 2026

Dear [Name],

Thank you for being a Halcyon Software customer. Your annual subscription renews on 15 November 2026, and we wanted to tell you about what's new this year.

What's new
- Single sign-on: let your team sign in through your existing identity provider.
- Audit export: export a record of activity for your compliance and review needs.
- 99.9% uptime commitment: a formal commitment to the availability of the service.

Renewal pricing
Your current price is 42,000.00 per year. The renewal price from 15 November 2026 will be 58,800.00 per year, an increase of 40%. This reflects the new capabilities above.

If you'd like to talk through the renewal, your plan, or your needs before the renewal date, I'm happy to set up a call.

Kind regards,
Chris Moreau
Account Manager, Halcyon Software

- **What I changed:** the pricing section states the figures. It gives the current price of 42,000.00, the renewal price of 58,800.00, and the 40% increase, and it offers a call to discuss the renewal.
- **Placeholder:** the recipient name is still `[Name]`.
- **Not sent:** the draft is saved for you to review and has not gone out.

If you're worried about how the increase will land, I can draft a version that emphasizes the value of the new features, or one that offers a call or a transition option. Any renewal terms or notice requirements in Brannock's contract are worth checking before this goes out.
